---
title: "Leaderboard"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

# Load dataset
scores <- read_csv(file.path("data", "scores.csv"))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

leaderboard <- scores %>%
  group_by(player) %>%
  summarise(
    "Total Rounds Played" = n(),
    "AverageScore" = mean(score),
    "Best Score" = max(score),
    "Worst Score" = min(score),
    "Score Standard Deviation" = sd(score),
    "Strikes/ Game" = sum(strikes)/n()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(AverageScore)) %>%
  rename("Average Score" = AverageScore) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 1))) %>%
  mutate(player = str_to_title(player)) %>%
  rename(Player = player)

leaderboard %>%
  datatable(options = list(
    dom = "t",
    paging = FALSE,
    searching = FALSE,
    info = FALSE,
    lengthChange = FALSE,
    columnDefs = list(
        list(orderSequence = c("desc", "asc"), targets = "_all")
      )
  )) 
```
